title: Cornell announces full review of Greek life after scrutiny over sexual assault case
summary_full: The university will conduct a series of measures after a former student was gang-raped at a fraternity house two years agoCornell University is set to announce a “full review” of fraternities and sororities determining their future on campus after an alleged sexual assault there has brought scrutiny to the system at the Ivy League school.University president Michael Kotlikoff announced the review on Monday in an update outlining several steps the institution has taken after a woman said she was gang raped at an on-campus fraternity’s house.
